---
applyTo: "app/src/**,feature-*/**,core/**,docs/conventions.md,docs/pitfalls.md"
---

# Conventions and pitfalls documentation

When introducing or changing a reusable pattern, coding standard, folder structure, naming convention, testing approach, or common mistake:

1. Update docs/conventions.md for durable conventions.
2. Update docs/pitfalls.md for recurring risks, fragile areas, or review checks.
3. Keep entries short, actionable, and evidence-based.
4. Do not add one-off implementation details as conventions.
5. Do not add generic advice that does not apply specifically to this repository.
